ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the nature of the angels?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Bayyinah characterizes the 'Kiraman Bararah' (Noble and Pious) as the angels who record deeds, emphasizing their absolute obedience (ta'ah) without independent will. This description underscores their role as divine agents of precision and honor, serving as a contrast to human beings who possess free will and are tested by these same noble recorders.
